title: Dasakam 65 – Gopikānāṃ Bhagavatsāmīpyaprāptiḥ
description: Krishna's flute draws the gopikas from their tasks; hurried adornment, inward devotion, and their arrival lead to Bhattathiri's closing prayer.

stanzas.sanskrit:
गोपीजनाय कथितं नियमावसाने
मारोत्सवं त्वमथ साधयितुं प्रवृत्तः ।
सान्द्रेण चान्द्रमहसा शिशिरीकृताशे
प्रापूरयो मुरलिकां यमुनावनान्ते ॥ ६५-१ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Krishna had promised Gopikas that He would spend time with them at the end of the Kathyaayini pooja. One cold night, on a full moon, in the forest on the banks of the river Yamuna, Krishna took his flute and started to play sweetly.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
gopījanāya kathitaṃ niyamāvasāne
mārotsavaṃ tvamatha sādhayituṃ pravṛttaḥ |
sāndreṇa cāndramahasā śiśirīkṛtāśe
prāpūrayo muralikāṃ yamunāvanānte || 65-1 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
सम्मूर्छनाभिरुदितस्वरमण्डलाभिः
सम्मूर्छयन्तमखिलं भुवनान्तरालम् ।
त्वद्वेणुनादमुपकर्ण्य विभो तरुण्य-
-स्तत्तादृशं कमपि चित्तविमोहमापुः ॥ ६५-२ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: The ascending and descending seven musical notes that radiated from the flute enchanted the whole world and hearing it from far, Gopikas instantly got attracted to it.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
sammūrchanābhiruditasvaramaṇḍalābhiḥ
sammūrchayantamakhilaṃ bhuvanāntarālam |
tvadveṇunādamupakarṇya vibho taruṇya-
-stattādṛśaṃ kamapi cittavimohamāpuḥ || 65-2 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
ता गेहकृत्यनिरतास्तनयप्रसक्ताः
कान्तोपसेवनपराश्च सरोरुहाक्ष्यः ।
सर्वं विसृज्य मुरलीरवमोहितास्ते
कान्तारदेशमयि कान्ततनो समेताः ॥ ६५-३ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: On hearing Krishna’s flute Gopikas who were taking care of their babies, few others were serving food to their husbands, few others were engaged in household chores  abandoned all the work and rushed to the forest to see him.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tā gehakṛtyaniratāstanayaprasaktāḥ
kāntopasevanaparāśca saroruhākṣyaḥ |
sarvaṃ visṛjya muralīravamohitāste
kāntāradeśamayi kāntatano sametāḥ || 65-3 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
काश्चिन्निजाङ्गपरिभूषणमादधाना
वेणुप्रणादमुपकर्ण्य कृतार्धभूषाः ।
त्वामागता ननु तथैव विभूषिताभ्य-
-स्ता एव संरुरुचिरे तव लोचनाय ॥ ६५-४ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Some of the gopikas dressed themselves well with jewellery. Some rushed half adorned with jewels, carrying rest in the hand and these gopikas looked more beautiful to Krishna's eyes.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
kāścinnijāṅgaparibhūṣaṇamādadhānā
veṇupraṇādamupakarṇya kṛtārdhabhūṣāḥ |
tvāmāgatā nanu tathaiva vibhūṣitābhya-
-stā eva saṃrurucire tava locanāya || 65-4 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
हारं नितम्बभुवि काचन धारयन्ती
काञ्चीं च कण्ठभुवि देव समागता त्वाम् ।
हारित्वमात्मजघनस्य मुकुन्द तुभ्यं
व्यक्तं बभाष इव मुग्धमुखी विशेषात् ॥ ६५-५ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: One charming faced Gopika in hurry to meet Krishna, put the necklace in her hip and waistband on her neck, as if to clearly indicate the attractiveness of her hips.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
hāraṃ nitambabhuvi kācana dhārayantī
kāñcīṃ ca kaṇṭhabhuvi deva samāgatā tvām |
hāritvamātmajaghanasya mukunda tubhyaṃ
vyaktaṃ babhāṣa iva mugdhamukhī viśeṣāt || 65-5 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
काचित् कुचे पुनरसज्जितकञ्चुलीका
व्यामोहतो परवधूभिरलक्ष्यमाणा ।
त्वामाययौ निरुपमप्रणयातिभार-
-राज्याभिषेकविधये कलशीधरेव ॥ ६५-६ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Another Gopika in her excitement to see Krishna, forgot her drape and carried only her intense love.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
kācit kuce punarasajjitakañculīkā
vyāmohataḥ paravadhūbhiralakṣyamāṇā |
tvāmāyayau nirupamapraṇayātibhāra-
-rājyābhiṣekavidhaye kalaśīdhareva || 65-6 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
काश्चिद्गृहात् किल निरेतुमपारयन्त्य-
-स्त्वामेव देव हृदये सुदृढं विभाव्य ।
देहं विधूय परचित्सुखरूपमेकं
त्वामाविशन् परमिमा ननु धन्यधन्याः ॥ ६५-७ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Few Gopikas were prevented from leaving the house by their husbands. They meditated on Krishna with such a deep devotion that they left their physical bodies and merged with Krishna. They were the most lucky ones to attain salvation.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
kāścidgṛhāt kila niretumapārayantya-
-stvāmeva deva hṛdaye sudṛḍhaṃ vibhāvya |
dehaṃ vidhūya paracitsukharūpamekaṃ
tvāmāviśan paramimā nanu dhanyadhanyāḥ || 65-7 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
जारात्मना न परमात्मतया स्मरन्त्यो
नार्यो गताः परमहंसगतिं क्षणेन ।
तं त्वां प्रकाशपरमात्मतनुं कथञ्चि-
-च्चित्ते वहन्नमृतमश्रममश्नुयाम् ॥ ६५-८ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Gopikas merely rushed to Krishna abandoning their homes not thinking Him as Paramatma but thinking that HE is their lover. These gopikas soaked their mind in the supreme bliss and meditated that they attained salvation so easily.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
jārātmanā na paramātmatayā smarantyo
nāryo gatāḥ paramahaṃsagatiṃ kṣaṇena |
taṃ tvāṃ prakāśaparamātmatanuṃ kathañci-
-ccitte vahannamṛtamaśramamaśnuvīya || 65-8 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
अभ्यागताभिरभितो व्रजसुन्दरीभि-
-मुग्धस्मितार्द्रवदनः करुणावलोकी ।
निस्सीमकान्तिजलधिस्त्वमवेक्ष्यमाणो
विश्वैकहृद्य हर मे पवनेश रोगान् ॥ ६५-९ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: The beautiful Gopikas of vraja were looking at the smiling and compassionate face of Krishna who showed unlimited mercy. Bhattathiri worshipped the one and only Bhagwan who steals the heart of all and requested Him to cure him of his afflictions.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
abhyāgatābhirabhito vrajasundarībhi-
-rmugdhasmitārdravadanaḥ karuṇāvalokī |
nissīmakāntijaladhistvamavekṣyamāṇo
viśvaikahṛdya hara me pavaneśa rogān || 65-9 ||
